findings.title: Making `.small-action` a flex container stops its `float: right` button from aligning right.
findings.body: `.small-action` is now `display: flex`. Browsers ignore `float` on flex items, so the `float: right` on `.small-action` `button` (and the `float: left` on `.topic-avatar`) no longer has any effect. Nothing in this rule pushes the button to the right edge: `.small-action-desc` doesn't grow and the button has no `margin-left: auto`. So small-action posts that show an edit/delete button will place it right after the description text instead of at the right edge. I couldn't check the markup order, so I don't know exactly where the button lands. Fix: add `margin-left: auto` to the button (or `flex: 1` to `.small-action-desc`), and remove the floats that no longer do anything.
